## 2. Retrieve, then answer from context only
The knowledge-base URL is configurable (KB_SEARCH_URL): the mock service, docs-rag-assistant or any search API. No context, an invalid model answer or low confidence all end in "I'm not sure" plus an escalation.

## 3. Reply, escalate, log
The reply goes out first. Escalations post the whole conversation to Slack; every Q&A is logged.
